findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_checkout · Private data: get_payment_methods, create_checkout, get_order, list_topups, create_wallet, get_wallet, create_deposit, get_deposit, purchase_esim · Public sink: create_checkout, create_wallet, create_deposit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_checkout · Private data: get_payment_methods, create_checkout, get_order, list_topups, create_wallet, get_wallet, create_deposit, get_deposit, purchase_esim · Public sink: create_checkout, create_wallet, create_deposit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
